text_block_list.text: When I went up to the rooftop to take a breather—

I could hear what sounded like
Seiun Sky groaning.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A-As you can see,
I was just doing vocal exercises...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ow ow ow, raising my voice
is making my head pound like crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, forget what I just said.
Nyahaha...
Though she says that, she seems to be suffering from a headache. It might be best to keep an eye on her.
